su-isat-60497344.d:
Key Responsibilities

1. Contract and Transaction Support

• Draft, review and negotiate agreements, order forms, correspondence and other legal documents for transactions within the assigned scope.
• Support pre-contract and post-contract activities, including contract execution, implementation, amendments, renewals, termination and contractual claims.
• Develop and maintain standard contract templates and legal playbooks to improve consistency and efficiency in deal execution.
• Coordinate with business teams and other relevant functions to ensure that contractual terms reflect agreed commercial arrangements and appropriate legal safeguards.

2. Contractual Compliance and Risk Management

• Identify and assess legal and contractual risks in proposed transactions and recommend practical mitigation measures.
• Review agreements and arrangements for compliance with applicable laws, regulations and internal policies relevant to the assigned scope.
• Support the incorporation of appropriate contractual protections and advise on relevant internal approval requirements.
• Escalate material risks, unresolved issues and deviations from approved contractual positions to the reporting manager in a timely manner.
• Work with relevant internal functions to address compliance issues arising during contract negotiation and implementation.

3. Legal Advisory and Business Support

• Provide day-to-day legal advice on the negotiation, execution, implementation, management and enforcement of contracts within the assigned scope.
• Monitor legal and regulatory developments relevant to telecommunications, AI, cloud, technology and commercial activities, and assess their implications for the Company.
• Conduct legal research and prepare clear, practical advice to support business decisions.

Qualification

Education

Min. bachelor’s degree in law (SH) from reputable universities in Indonesia.

Related Experienced

Min. 3-4 years of relevant experience in-house or at a law firm, preferably involving the drafting, review and negotiation of commercial and technology agreements, customer/reseller or revenue-sharing arrangements, strategic partnerships or transaction documents. Good knowledge of Indonesian contract and commercial law and relevant regulatory requirements. Exposure to the telecommunications, AI/cloud, data centre or technology infrastructure industry is an advantage.

Human Competency

• Strong analytical, drafting, negotiation, presentation and communication skills.
• Able to work independently and collaboratively, with a proactive, solutions-oriented and “can-do” attitude.
• Resourceful, conscientious, thorough and well-organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver assignments within the required timeline.
• Able to work effectively with cross-functional stakeholders in a multicultural and changing organizational environment.
• Demonstrates sound judgment, integrity and appropriate escalation of material legal or contractual risks.

Generic Competency

• Fluency and proficieny in English and Indonesian language, MS Office (outlook, word, excel, ppt)
• Strong computer skills, including proficiency with Microsoft Office products (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Visio).
• Familiarity with the use of AI/GenAI tools to support legal work (e.g., contract drafting/review assistance, legal research, document summarization) is an advantage.

wo-jpfa-JR3286.d:
Job Summary**

Ensure PT So Good Food Manufacturing adheres to all relevant laws, regulations, and internal policies, minimizing risk and promoting ethical business practices within the food manufacturing industry.

Job Responsibilities**

* Develop, implement, and maintain compliance policies and procedures in accordance with national and international food safety, quality, and business regulations.
* Conduct regular internal audits and assessments to identify potential compliance gaps and recommend corrective actions.
* Monitor changes in regulatory requirements and update internal policies and procedures accordingly.
* Prepare and submit necessary compliance reports to regulatory bodies and internal stakeholders.
* Provide training and guidance to employees on compliance-related matters, fostering a culture of compliance throughout the organization.
* Investigate and resolve compliance issues, complaints, or breaches, escalating complex cases to senior management.
* Collaborate with various departments (e.g., Legal, Quality Assurance, Production) to ensure compliance is integrated into all business operations.
* Assist in the development and implementation of risk management strategies related to compliance.
* Maintain accurate and organized records of compliance activities and documentation.

Job Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Law, Food Science, Food Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Proven experience in a compliance role, preferably within the food manufacturing or fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) industry.
* Strong understanding of relevant food safety regulations (e.g., HACCP, GMP, ISO 22000), quality management systems, and general business laws.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail.
* Ability to interpret complex regulations and translate them into practical business processes.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to train and influence others.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a dynamic environment.
* High level of integrity and ethical conduct.

PT Japfa Food Indonesia

Job Summary**

Responsible for providing comprehensive administrative support to the Finished Goods (FG) warehouse operations, ensuring efficient documentation, record-keeping, and coordination to maintain smooth inventory flow and data accuracy.

Job Responsibilities**

* Manage and maintain accurate inventory records for finished goods, including incoming, outgoing, and stock movements, using the company's inventory management system.
* Process and verify all warehouse-related documentation, such as delivery orders, shipping manifests, goods receipt notes, and stock transfer forms.
* Coordinate with production, logistics, and sales departments to ensure timely and accurate information exchange regarding finished goods availability and dispatch.
* Assist in generating daily, weekly, and monthly reports on inventory levels, stock discrepancies, and warehouse activity.
* Prepare and organize physical and digital filing systems for all warehouse documents, ensuring easy retrieval and compliance with company policies.
* Support warehouse team in conducting regular stock counts and reconciliation activities.
* Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders regarding order status, delivery schedules, and any issues related to finished goods.
* Maintain a clean and organized administrative workspace.
* Perform other administrative duties as assigned by the Warehouse Supervisor/Manager.

Job Qualifications**

* Minimum Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Proven experience (1-3 years) in a warehouse administration or inventory control role, preferably in a manufacturing or food industry setting.
* Proficient in using inventory management software and Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel).
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and record-keeping.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Understanding of warehouse operations and logistics processes.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new systems and procedures.
